exposure: Gut microbiota composition (altered via broad-spectrum antibiotic treatment and faecal microbiota transplant)
outcome: Pregnancy outcomes (foetal size, foetal viability, neonatal survival, pre-weaning growth)
cohort: Pregnant outbred Swiss Webster mice, infected with malaria in early gestation.
finding: The composition of the gut microbiota significantly influences malaria infection severity, which in turn dictates maternal morbidity and subsequent pregnancy outcomes, including foetal health and early postnatal survival.
followup_time: Pre-weaning period (including the first days of life)
birth_weight: Foetal size was assessed at term.
gest_age: Infection occurred in early gestation; assessments were made at mid-gestation and term.
